versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00019, SRS_Rte_00033 An RteBswEventToTaskMapping shall only own more than one RteBswEventRef reference if all owned RteBswEventRef s refer to BswOperationInvokedEvent s which in turn are triggering the same server ExecutableEntity .
